newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger says talks with NZ First "constructive".
newsitem.headline: Bolger says talks with NZ First "constructive".

text.p: Prime Minister Jim Bolger described talks on Wednesday morning between the caretaker National Party government and the New Zealand First Party about forming a coalition government as constructive.
"The talks are making progress," he told reporters after the talks.
He declined to say what topics were discussed or comment on the absence of NZ First leader Winston Peters from the meeting.

NZ First, which holds the balance of power after the inconclusive October 12 election, will hold further talks with the Labour Party later on Wednesday and with both National and Labour on Thursday. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
